description: This section covers crucial International Important Days observed globally. Direct facts regarding these dates and their significance are frequently asked in competitive exams under the Static GK section.

sections.title: Important Days Related to Environment and Nature
sections.description: Major days dedicated to raising awareness about the conservation of the Earth, climate, and ecosystems.

key_associations.extra_info: Highlights the importance of freshwater and advocates for the sustainable management of water resources.
An annual event to demonstrate support for environmental protection. It was first observed in 1970.
Aims to increase understanding and awareness of biodiversity issues worldwide.
The United Nations' principal vehicle for encouraging global awareness and action for the environment.
Commemorates the signing of the Montreal Protocol in 1987, aimed at preventing the depletion of the ozone layer.

historical_events.significance: June 5 was designated as World Environment Day during the landmark United Nations Conference on the Human Environment.

sections.title: Health and Medical Related International Days
sections.description: Days dedicated to raising awareness about global health issues and deadly diseases.

key_associations.extra_info: Aims to raise awareness of cancer and to encourage its prevention, detection, and treatment.
Marks the anniversary of the founding of the World Health Organization (WHO) in 1948.
Highlights the severe health risks and diseases associated with tobacco use.
Raises awareness of the need for safe blood and blood products, and thanks voluntary blood donors.
Dedicated to raising awareness of the AIDS pandemic caused by the spread of HIV infection.

important_facts.fact: The headquarters of the World Health Organization (WHO), the agency behind World Health Day, is located in Geneva, Switzerland.

sections.title: Human Rights, Women and Child Development Days
sections.description: Important days promoting social justice, equality, and fundamental human rights.

key_associations.extra_info: Celebrates the social, economic, cultural, and political achievements of women and advocates for gender equality.
Sanctioned by the International Labour Organization (ILO) to focus attention on the global extent of child labour and efforts to eliminate it.
Focuses attention on the urgency and importance of population issues, including family planning, poverty, and human rights.
Commemorates the day the UN General Assembly adopted the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in 1948.

sections.title: United Nations and International Cooperation Days
sections.description: Days associated with global peace, development, and the establishment of major international institutions.

key_associations.extra_info: Celebrates the crucial role of education for global peace and sustainable development.
Raises global awareness of the many physical and mental health benefits of practicing yoga.
Marks the anniversary of the entry into force of the UN Charter in 1945, which officially established the United Nations.

important_facts.fact: The proposal for the International Day of Yoga was introduced by India at the UN General Assembly and was first observed globally in 2015.

sections.title: Other Major International Days
sections.description: Important global days related to labour, youth, food security, and tourism.

key_associations.extra_info: Also known as May Day; it honors the contributions, achievements, and rights of workers and the working classes globally.
Draws international attention to youth issues and promotes their active engagement in society.
Raises awareness on the role of tourism within the international community and its social, cultural, and economic values.
Commemorates the founding of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) of the United Nations in 1945.
